verdict.line: You lose this lane if you let Volibear land Q (Thundering Smash) and chain into double W; you win it by poking from range and executing with R once it's up.

brief.thesis: Urgot's entire kit outranges Volibear's — Q (Corrosive Charge) hits from 800, W (Purge) from 490, while Volibear's Q and W only reach 300 and 325 and require him to physically close the gap. Whoever controls that distance decides the lane, and the numbers say it's you: 56.9% win rate over 1038 games, with both lane and solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.when: Q up and he's near gap-close range
theirWindow.what: He gap-closes with Q (Thundering Smash) for a stun, then doubles W (Frenzied Maul) on you for mark damage, bonus damage, and a heal on the second cast. Respect it or you eat the full combo.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With no stun and no zone to punish you, step up and poke freely with Q (Corrosive Charge) and autos — your range wins every exchange he can't force.

start.why: 85.6% pick rate and 55% win rate — the sustain and early trade damage matter since you're trading autos and Q pokes before either side has cooldown reduction.

boots.why: 55.5% win rate over 542 games; tenacity cuts the duration of Volibear's Q stun, directly shrinking his all-in window.

core.why: Armor shred stacks off your ranged pokes before Volibear can even close distance, and the haste keeps Q and Purge cycling faster.
The health and tenacity boost help you survive the one window Volibear actually lands — a stunned-into-double-W combo.
Highest-sample third item (56.3% over 176 games) — stacking resistances caps how much Volibear's on-hit W and passive magic damage can do over a long fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: Your ranged autos and Purge channel stack PTA fast, so you're already at full amplification by the time Volibear commits his Q — punishing the engage he's forced to make.

summoners.why: Highest win rate combo at 55.5% and by far the most-picked (84.6%); Ignite punishes through Volibear's W self-heal and secures the kills your range advantage sets up, especially once R is live.

playing.title: Poke from max range
playing.detail: Chip Volibear with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) before he's close enough to use anything; your kit is built to fight at a distance his isn't.

playing.title: Respect Thundering Smash windows
playing.detail: While his Q (12 to 10s cooldown) is up, don't stand inside 300 range — a landed stun chains straight into double W (Frenzied Maul) for mark damage, bonus damage, and a heal.

playing.title: Bait Sky Splitter before committing
playing.detail: E (Sky Splitter, 16s cooldown) damages and slows an area and shields him if he's in it; walk him into throwing it, then trade hard while it's down.

playing.title: Hold Purge for safe windows
playing.detail: W (Purge) slows you while firing, so only channel it when his Q is on cooldown — channeling into an available stun eats the whole combo.

playing.title: Save Disdain to punish the engage
playing.detail: E (Disdain) shields you and hurls him away if he commits Q; holding it lets you shield through his stun and shove him back out to max range.

playing.title: Hunt executes with R at level 6+
playing.detail: Once R (Fear Beyond Death) is up, look for the all-in — there's no escape from the impale, and the data's solo-kill edge is yours to use.

playing.title: Finish through his W heal
playing.detail: Ignite burns through the sustain he gets from recasting W on you, so commit to kills rather than letting him heal back to safety.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the ability mechanics and tactical reasoning are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Volibear’s (E) and (Q) by keeping your distance. Use basic attacks and [Q] and try to get a kill when [R] is off cooldown.
